subject: Post-demo alignment: procurement signals, econ buyer & enablement kit
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@quantaflow.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Mehta <pmehta@quantaflow.com>, Michael Chen <mchen@quantaflow.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo today — quick recap and next steps

Hi Hannah / Ben — great demo today, thanks for tailoring the latency/throughput examples to our batch inference use case. Quick recap from our side and asks so we stay aligned: 

1) Economic buyer: Priya Mehta (CFO) said she wants a short ROI brief (2 slides + topline TCO estimate) that compares current CPU-based batch costs vs Redwood Dedicated on an annualized basis. Priya copied here.

2) Security & compliance: Michael Chen (Head of Infra/Sec) will run the SOC2 questionnaire and wants to see KV-cache retention controls, data at rest encryption, and a redline on data retention SLA. Michael copied. He asked if you can provide a completed RFI by next Tues.

3) Procurement path: Procurement moves fairly quickly but requires a PO + standard terms review after SOC2/RFI. Target timeline is ~6 weeks from PO to go-live if we can lock commercial terms. Procurement contact is Priya's team.

4) Ask for Champion enablement: Liam is our internal champion — he asked for a 1-page talk-track he can use with Priya (economic highlights + top 3 risk mitigations) and a brief ROI table. Also asked for an internal one-pager for Michael that summarizes security controls + where Redwood would provide evidence.

I attached our internal procurement template for reference (Quantaflow-Procurement-Checklist.pdf) — please confirm if you can deliver the RFI answers and the two one-pagers by EOD Monday (their Monday). If not, propose timing.

Thanks,
Liam
Senior ML Engineer — QuantaFlow

--- Original attachment stub: Quantaflow-Procurement-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf) ---

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@quantaflow.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Mehta <pmehta@quantaflow.com>, Michael Chen <mchen@quantaflow.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — quick recap and next steps

Thanks Liam — appreciated. Internal plan below and commit dates so your team knows what to expect.

Hannah -> Deliverables & owners (summary):
- RFI / SOC2 answers: Marissa Cole will complete and provide evidence links (they'll include KV-cache controls, encryption, retention policy text). ETA: Tue 2027-06-15 EOD PST. (Attachment: Quantaflow_RFI_answers.pdf)
- Econ buyer brief (2-slide ROI + topline TCO): Ben Carter will produce the ROI slide and an annualized cost table vs your current CPU baseline. ETA: Mon 2027-06-14 noon PST.
- Security one-pager for Michael: short Q&A doc + pointer to audit logs and key mgmt pages. Marissa will include. ETA: Tue 2027-06-15.
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template: I'll send a filled MAP with milestones and acceptance criteria by Wed 2027-06-16. (I'll share as spreadsheet).

Champion enablement (for Liam):
- Ben will draft a 5-bullet talk-track (economic lift, risk mitigations, go-live path, quick wins, ask).
- Marissa will prepare the security summary (2 bullets + links to evidence) for Michael.

Scheduling: Ben — can you confirm you can turn the ROI table around by Monday noon PST? Marissa — confirm RFI availability for Tue? Sergio — I'll loop you on contract gate questions if Procurement pushes on payment terms.

Liam / Priya / Michael — would you prefer a 15-min prep call with Priya before we hand the ROI slides to her, or should we send slides first and line up a follow-up?

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0112

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@quantaflow.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Mehta <pmehta@quantaflow.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — quick recap and next steps

On it — quick note on approach and draft talk-track for Liam. I can deliver the ROI slide + cost table by Mon 2027-06-14 12:00 PST. High level calculations I'm using: current prod costs = weighted average of CPU batch jobs ($/hr * avg concurrent nodes), projected Redwood Dedicated costs = reserved GPU + expected batching gains (we'll show token-level and per-call comparison).

Draft 5-bullet talk-track for Liam (use short lines when speaking to Priya):
1) Annual cost comparison: show current baseline vs Redwood after batching & cache — estimated 45% lower unit cost in our sample projection.
2) Productivity gains: faster retrain-to-deploy cycles, fewer infra tickets; tie to engineering headcount savings.
3) Predictable spend: Dedicated capacity + reserved commit reduces month-to-month variance.
4) Risk controls: encryption at rest, strict KV-cache retention, per-route RBAC, and SOC2 evidence ready.
5) Next ask: commit to short pilot + PO to validate 6-week go-live.

Redlines / procurement notes: if Procurement insists on significant warranty changes, we should propose a limited liability cap tied to committed spend. Sergio — want your thumbs up on that before we hand an LOI/terms doc.

I'll attach the cost table in the shared drive link and send slides in a minute.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
--- Attachment stub: ROI_QF-112_slide.pdf ---

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@quantaflow.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <mchen@quantaflow.com>, Priya Mehta <pmehta@quantaflow.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — quick recap and next steps

Hi team — RFI/status update and the two short one-pagers are attached. Notes below.

1) RFI: completed answers with references to SOC2 controls and technical pages. See Quantaflow_RFI_answers.pdf (attached). I called out how Redwood handles KV cache encryption and retention windows, and included a link to our audit-log sampling process.

2) Security one-pager for Michael: 3 bullets + links. (Attachment: Security_onepager_QF-112.pdf)

3) Champion one-pager for Liam: 1-page talk track + ROI topline. I'm copying the two talk-lines we recommend for conversations with CFO-level and for the Head of Infra. 
   - CFO line: "We can reduce your batch inference unit costs ~40–50% with predictable reserved capacity while shortening iteration cycles for models."
   - Infra line: "Redwood retains only encrypted KV snapshots per your retention policy; we provide audit logs and a data-retention SLA you can reference in the contract."

4) Open question for Procurement: they asked about indemnity and data-usage clauses. If Procurement wants to remove our standard data-use clause, we should propose a negotiated addendum limited to the pilot scope.

Deliverables attached: Quantaflow_RFI_answers.pdf, Security_onepager_QF-112.pdf, Champion_talktrack_QF-112.pdf

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
